title: Billing
description: Your plan, automatic payments and Shaddai payments.
readOnly: The account is read-only: everything can be viewed but not added or edited. It works again as soon as you pay.

auto.title: Automatic payment
auto.none: Pay every month with Mercado Pago (card or account balance). It is charged automatically and you can cancel anytime.
auto.cancelled: Automatic payment is cancelled. You can turn it back on anytime.
auto.noPrice: Your plan has no price in pesos yet. Write to us at {{email}}.
auto.pending: You started the subscription but the payment in Mercado Pago is not complete.
auto.paused: The automatic payment is paused in Mercado Pago.
auto.disabled: Online payment is not enabled yet. To pay, write to us at {{email}}.

cancel.title: Cancel automatic payment
cancel.body: No more charges will be made. What you already paid is valid until {{date}}; after that the account becomes read-only until you pay again.

fake.title: Test mode (no real money)
fake.body: This environment uses a test provider. Simulate the charge result:
fake.returned: You are back from the test checkout. Simulate the charge with the buttons below.

manual.title: Record a manual payment
manual.hint: Bank transfer, cash or other. It extends the paid period and, if the account was on trial or overdue, activates it.
